about: Fact-checker eval cases (pnpm eval:factcheck). Each case is a shipped lesson from a 2026-09-30/10-01 course run, read from <corpus>/<course>.json (not committed: it holds third-party source text). A label matches a fact-check issue whose claim contains any of its `match` strings (case-insensitive). truth: supported = a cited passage states it, so flagging it is a false alarm; error = not supported by the lesson's sources or wrong, so it should be flagged; either = the cited passage states it but another passage or current fact disagrees (not scored). Lessons with no labels passed their original check: any issue on them is reported as unlabeled.
